name: Zbelítov (Czechia)
description: Divided by a wavy diagonal line from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a yellow upper hoist part bearing a blue bell and a blue lower fly part bearing a yellow cross.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 21 April 2020 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
